verdict.rationale: Decagon documents several user-configurable processes that run without a human in the loop. Watchtower applies natural-language criteria to every interaction. Proactive agents initiate outreach calls at chosen moments in the customer journey. Duet and Suggestions automatically iterate on the agent and draft knowledge content from conversation data. However, these are fixed product features scoped to customer support, not a general facility for building arbitrary background automations. Missing for 10: user-defined triggers or schedules for custom background jobs, docs on configuring autonomous workflows outside conversations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
